description: [Trip-Pups(트립펍스) — 외국인 축제 찾기·신청] Sign the traveler up for a small-group day out hosted by Trip-Pups (events marked hosted_by: trippups). This completes the sign-up: it is recorded and the team sees it. Only call it after the traveler has given these details themselves and said yes in this conversation. Never guess or fill in a detail. Does not work for other organizers' events. Privacy notice: https://trip-pups.com/hi/weekly#privacy

age_confirmed.description: True only if the traveler confirmed they are 14 or older

consent.description: True only if the traveler agreed to the privacy notice

contact.description: Email or @Instagram, where the meeting details go

event_id.description: Event id from search_events, starting with tp-weekly-

phone.description: Optional. Phone or WhatsApp from any country, with country code, e.g. +1 555 123 4567. No Korean number needed; leave it out if they'd rather not give one.

school.description: Their school, or how long they're in Korea

name: join_meetup
title: Join a Trip-Pups day out (signs up for real)
